source_citation: Chandler, Zilberman and Sprintall(2022), Seasonal to Decadal Western Boundary Current Variability From Sustained Ocean Observations, doi:10.1029/2022GL097834.
axis_method: Author midpoint depth integration and five-point triangular smoothing weights1,2,3,2,1 divided by9; reject two longitudinal edge points. First identify the minimum integrated northward velocity west of150E; then choose maximum northward integrated velocity strictly west of that minimum, as the source PX40 code does. Do not select the strongest offshore Kuroshio Extension meander or copy a southward minimum selector.
axis_gate_interpretation: Additional OSW identity plausibility check138–145E after the source separator-based selector; outside-gate months remain unknown, with no forced relocation. Preserve source Kuroshio segment east of Izu Ridge, distinct from offshore KE meanders.
vertical_method: At each monthly horizontal axis retain all native depths of maximum positive northward poleward speed. Diagnose first descending0/0.05/0.1m/s crossings below the deepest tied maximum only between adjacent finite native levels. Missing samples stop diagnosis; no extrapolation to seabed or1975m terminal depth.
seasonal_method: For each calendar month combine16 year-specific current-following axis profiles. A mean value at a native level requires all16 profiles finite at that level, keeping contributors fixed. Diagnose the mean profile separately from individual monthly-profile crossings. No3month smoothing and no averaging of diagnosed depths is substituted for a velocity-profile mean.
reconstruction_scope: Monthly sections2004–2019 combine HR-XBT, Argo and SLA; they are reconstructed estimates, not192 independent direct sections. PX40 HR-XBT occupations cover2012–2019 and SLA reconstruction extends the monthly product to2004. Hydrographic structure is statistically extended below600m. Reference velocities near1000m are time-invariant means;1975m is a product limit, not current bottom.
velocity_uncertainty_scope: Source vel_err is the standard error of Argo reference velocity, not depth uncertainty. Retain variable metadata but do not manufacture depth confidence intervals or transfer transport standard errors.
geometry_scope: One nominal PX40 Yokohama–Honolulu transect. Source-selected Kuroshio segment downstream of Izu Ridge is distinct from farther-offshore KE meanders. No assignment of this descriptor to the full Kuroshio route, KE or North Pacific Current; no thickness, physical width or volume inferred.
